house-of-quirk-store-set-of-2-innerwear-.text:
Set of 2 Innerwear Organisers
Set of 2 Innerwear Organiser Closet Drawer Divider, 24 Cell Collapsible Closet Cabinet Underwear Storage Boxes for Storing Socks, Lingerie, Underwear
Light and breathable:Beige Organiser is made of non woven fabric material,surrounded by 4pcs 2.0mm thick cardboard,dividers are sewn together and each slot shares the same bottom
Easy to assemble:There is a zipper diagonally across the bottom, just need zip to use it,zipper can help keep it's square shape and allows you to fold when not in use,saving a lot of space
Cleaning method: Because organiser contains cardboard inside,please do not wash drawer organizer divider directly in water or washing machine.It is recommended to wipe with a dry towel
Large capacity: 24 slots with same size,each pockets is about 78.5*52.5mm/3.1*2.06 Inch, suitable for ties, underwear, panties or socks (light or medium weight sock),not recommended for bra or heavy winter socks
Matters need attention:It will have some cardboard smell, please put it in a ventilated position for 24 hours before use or can put an air freshener in one slot to remove odor
